Name: Who Lives Here
Author: klatuprism
Description:
A display box is shown above each animal house showing which animal types live in the building and indicates if they have eaten today.  The display is toggled by pressing [CTRL][N], this is configurable via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] or by editing the config.json file.


[size=4][u]Colour Code[/u]
[/size]The background colour of the animal indicates it current location and feeding status:

No background colour - At home and fed.
All Brown background colour - Outdoors and fed.
All Red background colour - At home and not fed.
Brown and Red background colour - Outdoors and not fed.

Any empty slots in an animal house will be indicated by an empty purple box.

[u][size=4]Expanded Capacity Animal Houses[/size][/u]
For those using mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4861]Increase Animal House Max Population[/url] I have extended the display to accommodate larger number of building occupants. The display will show 18 animals at a time and then you can either manually change the page tab (by left clicking on the building) or wait for the display to cycle through the pages automatically.  The page delay can be specified in the configuration.  You also enable the skipping of empty tabs via GMCM.


[size=4][u]Auto -Toggle[/u][/size]
You can specify a time for the display to auto-pop as well as a time to auto-hide the display.  The times are configurable via GMCM.

[u][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/u]
[list]
[*]BFAV - I have tested against the latest unofficial release and all things work fine
[*]Increased Animal House Max Population - works  fine
[*]Other Custom Buildings - I have not tested any custom buildings, but as long as the building interior is an AnimalHouse it should be compatible.
[/list][u][size=4]Language Support[/size][/u]
Translations are supported and welcome.
Current languages:
[list]
[*]English
[/list]
